$comment: Project settings for the technical-team plugin. Only you edit this file: the guard blocks every team agent from writing .claude/. By default agents run anything the denylist does not block; set "strictCommands": true to make the commands.* lists strict allowlists (each entry is a command prefix). Set "strictSkills": true to restrict skills to run-kit, the plugin skills of the role and the skills.<role> lists (default: any skill may be loaded). Path lists extend the plugin defaults in config/ownership.json; adding docs/** to paths.docs lets the writer use it again instead of .team/docs/. The db section is used when a database specialist (Bash level db-local, e.g. dba) is active: its DB commands must target a host in allowedHosts and a database matching allowedDatabases (glob), given explicitly in the command or through envFile; no other role may run db.commands. Leave db.commands empty to use the plugin's default list. skills: per-role lists of skills an agent may load with the Skill tool (project skills by name, plugin skills as <plugin>:<skill>); the lead names the fitting ones in each brief; run-kit is always allowed, and so is the plugin skill live-preview for qa, developer and designer. Put the UI/UX design skills you install (e.g. from GitHub) under skills.designer and the matching frontend skills under skills.developer. externalAgents: non-team agents the lead may call (default ["Explore"]); they always run read-only under the guard, also when you start them yourself. Set [] to turn it off.
